ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 它说喜欢Mortis

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
不过，她说过，
总会有人再创造新的归宿

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
灯的演出，已经开始了。
快点

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 每天。直到奶奶落锁为止，一直

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
我以为它会存在一辈子。
但现在没有了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
可是，这里有一个
有趣的女人

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我不去。我要在SPACE弹一辈子吉他

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
灯的演出要开始了。
来打鼓

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 别人不懂吉他，也不懂我的心情

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
缺了一块。
最好不要用那个弹了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
以前开过LIVEHOUSE。
『SPACE』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 如果不认真的话，会被人骂吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 之前的演出很开心……还不办演出吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 像呼吸一样平常

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
……！
社团的点心……这个很好吃。我要

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我吃了抹茶芭菲，所以没事

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
荞麦面。
从便利店买来的

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 哼、哼哼、哼哼、哼哼哼……♪

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
我弹吉他。
乐谱是这个吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 都是些无聊的女人

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我还想多吃点抹茶点心

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 没有演出所以不去

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
下次演出是什么时候？
我要演出

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 玩乐队。给我看乐谱

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 结束了，就是结束了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 哼……有趣的女孩子

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: Rikki，来敲鼓

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_027
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: （明明那里最好）

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_028
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 乐队的曲子都会弹了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_029
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我得走了，拜拜
